summary: Plastec Technologies, Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting fiscal 2025 financial results and disclosing that it commenced voluntary liquidations of its BVI-incorporated subsidiaries on March 24, 2026, which are expected to complete in approximately 7 weeks. The liquidation is part of a strategic move to eliminate ongoing operations; upon completion, the company will have no subsidiaries or operating activities. No purchase price, premium, or advisor is mentioned. The company retains $5.4 million in cash. Watch for regulatory approvals and potential return of capital to shareholders post-liquidation.
